title: Blog Card — Wide
description: The post row the live blog landing and every category archive render. A two-thirds body column carries a centred title, an italic author/date line, the category list and the excerpt; a one-third image sits on the trailing edge and is dropped below the small breakpoint. A rule closes each row. Measured from `.blog #primary .post-wrapper .entry-layout` on 2026-08-20: body 67%, image flex-basis 31.5% with min-height 250px, title #60483B centred, meta and categories italic and centred, excerpt centred, `.lsx-breaker` beneath. This is the treatment style.md 12.6 recorded as not ported — "a horizontal list row … that is composition, not a token decision". It is ported here so the composition can be judged; blog-card.json and blog-card-large.json are untouched and still carry their KWV structure, which is why all three appear side by side on the card reference page. The small-breakpoint stack lives in assets/styles/core-group.css: the css field silently *unwraps* @media, flattening the rules inside it into unconditional ones — which hid the image at every width, not just below 781px.

styles.css: & { display: flex; flex-flow: row nowrap; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--wp--preset--spacing--40); padding-bottom: var(--wp--preset--spacing--50); } & > * { margin-block: 0 !important; } & .blog-card-wide__body { flex: 1 1 67%; text-align: center; } & .blog-card-wide__media { flex: 0 0 31.5%; align-self: stretch; margin: 0 !important; } & .blog-card-wide__meta { color: var(--wp--preset--color--brand-600); font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--200); font-style: italic; line-height: var(--wp--custom--line-height--body); } & .blog-card-wide__body p { line-height: var(--wp--custom--line-height--body); } & .blog-card-wide__media figure { margin: 0 !important; line-height: 0; }
